name: Fix: persona chat editor must apply on "Done" and discard on close
description:
BUG (small, UI). Reported by management:
"When editing a profile's persona using chat, when user press 'Done' we'll take last message and add to the profile's content. Allow to close chat without changes."

OBJECTIVE
Two clear behaviours in the chat-based persona editor:
- Pressing "Done" → the last chat message becomes the profile/persona content (applied to the draft).
- Closing the editor without pressing "Done" (X button, backdrop click, Escape) → no change at all to the persona content.

WHERE IT LIVES (confirmed)
- `client/src/components/team-view/ContentEditorModal.vue` — the editor modal.
  * Header X button, backdrop `@click`, and the Escape handler all emit `close`.
  * `onChatUpdated(chat)` currently emits `update` with the last message content on EVERY chat event:
        this.$emit('update', { content, chatId: chat.id })
    Because the parent writes it straight into the draft, the persona is already changed before "Done" is pressed — that is the bug.
- `client/src/components/team-view/TeamMemberDrawer.vue` — the parent:
  * `openContentEditor()` (Persona tab, "Edit with chat" button) sets `showContentEditor = true`.
  * `onContentUpdated({ content, chatId })` writes `this.draft.content = content` and `this.draft.chat_id = chatId`.

REQUIRED BEHAVIOUR
1. While chatting, the modal keeps the candidate content LOCALLY (e.g. `pendingContent`) — it must NOT emit `update`.
2. "Done" button → emit `update` with `{ content: <last message content>, chatId: <chat id> }` and then emit `close`. This is the only path that may change the persona.
3. Close (X button, backdrop, Escape) → emit `close` only. `draft.content` must be byte-identical to what it was when the editor was opened.
4. Linking the editor chat is NOT a content change: it is acceptable to keep `chatId` in sync (so reopening resumes the same chat). If that makes the discard logic harder, prefer correctness of `content` over keeping `chatId`.
5. Do not save to the server from the modal: the drawer's own "Save member" button remains the only persistence step. Pressing Done must not save the profile.
6. Update the copy so the UI tells the truth:
   - header subtitle ("Ask the assistant to rewrite this persona, then close this dialog." → should mention pressing Done to apply);
   - footer hint ("The last assistant message becomes the persona content.").
7. Also check `client/src/components/ProfileChatEditor.vue`: it emits `content-changed` on every message change (same pattern). If it is currently rendered inside a dialog with Done/Cancel actions, apply the same rule there; if it is only used as a live preview with no Done button, leave it untouched and say so in the result.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- Open Persona tab → "Edit with chat" → chat 2-3 messages → close with X → reopen → persona content unchanged.
- Same test with the Escape key and with a backdrop click.
- Chat → press "Done" → persona field now shows the last assistant message; then "Cancel"/"Save member" behave as before.
- No regression when reopening a profile that already has a `chat_id` (chat resumes, content still unchanged unless Done is pressed).
- Lint/build green. In the result, list the files changed and the manual verification performed.

messages.content:
Fix the "Edit with chat" persona editor: apply the persona only when the user presses "Done", and allow closing the dialog without touching the profile content.

Root cause: in client/src/components/team-view/ContentEditorModal.vue the method onChatUpdated() emits `update` with the last chat message on EVERY chat change, so the drawer draft (draft.content) is mutated live and closing the dialog keeps the change.

Required:
- Keep the latest chat content locally in the modal (e.g. pendingContent) and do NOT emit `update` while chatting.
- "Done" → emit `update` with { content: last message content, chatId } and then close.
- Close via X / backdrop / Escape → emit only `close`; profile.content must remain exactly what it was.
- Linking the editor chat id (chatId) on creation is fine, but it must never modify `content`.
- Update the footer hint text and the header subtitle to describe the new behaviour.

Acceptance: chat about the persona, close with X → open again → content unchanged. Chat, press Done → content becomes the last message. Lint/build green. Report the files changed.
